Native 200%: actual complete browser content surface 1440×813 pixels inside a 1440×900 browser window, with 720×406 CSS layout and DPR2. Both top and middle scroll captures were actually viewed. Text, close control and main action buttons remain legible/reachable; middle capture shows the complete then-current overview bird. The earlier cropped capture alone is not used as full-surface proof.

After real context restoration, the paired detail image and the regular world are visibly rendered; fieldbook count4 remains visible. Underlying unchanged model/run/book assertions are recorded by the native driver, not inferred solely from the screenshot.
limits: Cloud Chromium154; no physically tested iPad/Safari.
